text:
Qatar Airways is the best-supported answer for the world’s favourite airline, based on winning Skytrax’s passenger-voted “World’s Best Airline” more often than any other carrier in recent years. Singapore Airlines is the usual closest rival in those same rankings. British Airways’ old line “The World’s Favourite Airline” was an advertising slogan, while awards like Skytrax are the nearest widely cited global measure.

CONFIDENCE: 62
